I said enough!\nYou mean I'm still a novice?!
N-No!! I-I didn't mean it that way...\nI'm just worried. What if it is broken and...
Look! You think I'm inexperienced and going to\nbreak it!!
How dare you treat me like a child...\nBe prepared!!
N-No! Please! Stop!\nPlease calm down!
It looks like a serious matter...
Y-You!
O-Oh, it's you.\nAre you here to slay the dragon too?\n...Oops. It's nothing.
My brother made fun of me during practice, so...
He sounded more like a subordinate or something...
What? ...N-No way! She's my little sister...\nAnd, she's still not good at wielding swor...
What? ...N-No way! She's my little sister...\nAnd, she's still not good at wielding swor...\nAggghh!
Oh, excuse me my beloved brother.\nBut I believe you'd better watch your mouth.
Triel and Balft look a bit flustered...
B-By the way, have you heard that the dragon is\nnesting in Nisel Mountain? Well, it's not just\nstaying there.
The monsters around here became much fiercer\nbecause of its miasma.
And the mountain is [ff6464]filled with the miasma,\nso we can't enter it right now[ffffff]...
[ffff64]Purification Incense[ffffff] can get rid of the miasma but...\nIt's too expensive for us.
So, we were gonna go back to the city to ask the\nsynthesist to make the incense but...
We were surrounded by monsters and got stuck here.
So, could you give us a hand to slay the dragon?
We'll drive the monsters away and clear the way\nfor you. So, could you go buy the incense?
I believe [ffff64]Pelulu has Purification Incense.[ffffff]\nShe's in Reug Salt Plains. I'm counting on you.
Okay, Triel!\nLet's defeat the monsters for the adventurer!
Certainly, sir.\nHopefully, a novice can be of help.
Oh, c'mon.\nPlease just forget it...
You handed Purification Incense to Triel.
I really appreciate it.\nI'm relieved you come back safe and sound.
Yes, it was a bit hard but we managed to get here.\nBalft, the Purification Incense.
*pant* ...Wow! Thanks...!\nHuh? I'm alright. *pant*
You know, we had to deal with lots of monsters...\nIt was tough but....\n*pant* Triel, let's begin.
Okay...
Triel burned the Purification Incense and put it\nbefore the way covered with the miasma.
The smoke spread toward the purple miasma and\ncleared it up...\nYou can enter Nisel Mountain now!
Now we can enter Nisel Mountain.\nThank you so much.
Nisel Mountain is huge.\nWe have no idea where the dragon is at all.\nWe should split up and search for it.
Can you go alone? ...Okay.\nLet's inform everyone immediately when you find\nthe dragon. Keep your guard up.
